name: Revivals Religious
overview: The Scriptures highlight revival as a return to wholehearted devotion to God, exemplified by King Hezekiah's reign in Judah. Hezekiah began his rule by doing what was right in the sight of the LORD, removing idolatrous practices and trusting fully in God, setting him apart from other kings. His commitment to obeying God's commandments and rejecting false worship underscores revival as a cleansing and renewing of faith that brings a people back to faithful covenant relationship with the LORD.
